text_block_list.text:
Lunch break. As I passed by the classroom, 
Tamamo Cross had her head in her hands.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: No good! I don't get it at all-!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe. Even the great Tamamo-san finding 
this tough, huh~?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Good timing. Right now... I'm caught in 
Jordan's trap.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
It's not a trap, it's a price-guessing 
game!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Man, the other day I showed Tamamo-san 
some of City's cosmetics, and—

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
...*Sniff*... *sniff sniff*. ...Nah, this 
is seriously expensive too. It's gotta be 
well over ten grand.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Correct. It's the powder I got from that 
photoshoot the other day.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Wait, then what about, what about this 
one!? The lipstick on the far right!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: So cheap!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ding-dong! It's my budget buy! Only 390 
yen!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Still, aren't you supposed to not care 
about cosmetics? How'd you even know that? 
That's hilarious~!"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, that's easy-peasy. Expensive 
stuff... smells like pure money!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...So because they said that, I brought 
some super tricky stuff for them to guess.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Aye, these are the shoes! They're just too 
perfect!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
*sniff, sniff*... Kinda smells like 
money... or maybe it doesn't...!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Btw, if you guess right, you get a free 
lunch coupon for the cafeteria!"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I really, really wanna win!! I wanna hit 
the jackpot!! But I have no clue!!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: "Hey, Trainer! Got any good ideas?"
choice_data_list: I'll give strength training a try!
I'll go for a run and find out for myself!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Muscle training! For sure, if I move 
around in 'em, it'll be way easier to 
compare with my usual shoes!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Alright, here we go! Ooonnee, twooo, 
threeee—

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Th-This is...!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
A fluffy touch, a snug fit wrapping around 
the hoof! A horseshoe that fits like a 
glove!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
That's a pretty sweet item, right?! 
20,000... nah, it's easily worth 25,000! 
And that's my final answer!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe, okie-dokie. Now then, for the 
moment of truth, the correct answer is—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: 5,000 yen! That was pretty cheap~!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Eeeh?!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to blow Tamamo-san's mind, so I 
asked around my class and found out about 
some cheap and super cute shoes~!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Y-You totally freaked out, didn'tcha~?!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
No way! Is this really that cheap?! Whoa! 
I'm getting so hyped!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
...Whoa, I'm buying this next. What brand 
is it?

Tamamo Cross was in high spirits for a 
while, having discovered such good quality 
at low prices.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"True! Why didn't I realize it sooner?! 
Runnin' it yourself is the best way to 
find out!"

And so, we moved over to the grounds, and 
after running around for a few dozen 
minutes—

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah, whew...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Well?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Fufun, I get it perfectly! The texture, 
the fit! These horseshoes are locked in 
tight!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
—Thinking about just this part, it's a 
luxury item worth over 20,000 yen! But 
still!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Once I put them on, they mold right to my 
feet! Just the right amount of comfort and 
support!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
So basically, the answer is slightly 
cheap! Final answer!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, spot on! You really are insane! I'll 
bring over a free voucher later～!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Hell yeah!!

During lunch break the next day, Tamamo 
Cross was reportedly spotted humming 
happily in the cafeteria.
